parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number to start displaying results from. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: DeviceName
parameters.description:
The device name.

If you specify this parameter and set **FuzzyName** to **true**, a fuzzy search is performed. In this case, the **DeviceName** value is a prefix string of the device name and must be more than 4 characters in length.

parameters.name: FuzzyName
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to perform a fuzzy search based on the **DeviceName** value.
- **true**: Perform a fuzzy search.
- **false** (default): Do not perform a fuzzy search.

parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description:
The group ID, which is the globally unique identifier of the group.

You can call the [QueryDeviceGroupList](~~93356~~) operation to query the group ID (**GroupId**).

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token for the next page. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 200. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the product to which the device belongs.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The device status. Valid values:

- **ONLINE**: The device is online.
- **OFFLINE**: The device is offline.
- **UNACTIVE**: The device is not activated.
- **DISABLE**: The device is disabled.
